title: Applet: state of presentation mode switch is not synchronized across multiple instances
line: Turning presentation mode on or off in one Display Configuration widget now updates the switch in every other one.
explanation: The presentation mode switch state was a plain property of each applet's QML, set only by that applet's own switch. The inhibition cookie itself is already shared within plasmashell by the powermanagement engine, but a second widget had no way to know the mode was on, so its switch stayed off (and the applet filters plasmashell's own inhibition out of its hint). The change adds a presentationModeEnabled property to the applet's C++ class backed by a static value that notifies every instance; the switches and the applet's active status/tooltip bind to it.

commits.message:
plasmoid: share presentation mode state between applet instances

Each Display Configuration widget kept its own presentation mode state, so
enabling it in one left the switch off in every other one. Store the state
in the applet class, shared by all instances, and bind the switches to it.

BUG: 426426

media.caption: Presentation mode enabled in the desktop widget; the tray's Display Configuration switch is still off.
Same steps with the fix: the tray's switch is on too, and the tray icon shows presentation mode is active.

review.text: Per-process static state shared by all applet instances is a pragmatic fix; the inhibition cookie was already process-wide in the engine, only the UI state was per-instance. Deriving it from PowerDevil's inhibition list would be the ideal source of truth, but the engine keys entries by app name and the applet filters plasmashell out, so that would be messier. Screenshot shows both switches on.
